deadline.value: The college asks for applications by 1 January for Fall; the CS page gives no separate date.
deadline.quote: apply by January 1 for maximum consideration for Fall and Summer admission

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional, and scores are considered if you submit them.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores — optional, and considered if submitted

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT overall score of 90.
toefl_min.quote: the TOEFL iBT (minimum overall score of 90)

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic overall band of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: the IELTS Academic (minimum overall band score of 6.5)

english_waiver.value: Applicants whose native language is not English need an approved test; the page lists no exemption for Indian degrees.
english_waiver.quote: International applicants whose native language is not English must demonstrate proficiency

supervisor.value: Admission depends on a faculty advisor being available for you.
supervisor.quote: Admission is contingent upon the availability of an appropriate faculty advisor

funding.value: Every PhD student receives a tuition waiver and a stipend.
funding.quote: Every Ph.D. student receives full funding

entry_route.value: A bachelor's or master's in computer science or a closely related discipline is needed.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must hold a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a closely related discipline

notes: New PhD starting Fall 2026 (catalog code COSC-PHD). Admission is conditional on advisor availability. Research areas include AI/ML and data science, but these are research areas, not a separate program, so no datasci record was made.
